texts.en: Greetings, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! We understand that your empire has come into possession of a cache of data containing the brain scans of an extinct species, taken from the very world they once inhabited. Even though your species is still too primitive to utilize this data, we laud your efforts in preserving this last remnant of a once vibrant civilization. As part of our efforts to conserve and catalog endangered species in our Endangered Species Preserve, we wish to take this data and use our cloning technologies to bring a small number of this species back to life. Will you share it with us so we can fulfill their last wish together?

# 来自[FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]的通讯 / Communication from [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]

- 分类 Category: C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · 来源 Sources: events/fallen_empire_tasks_events.txt:2023-2152; common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:602 · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

异种友好的堕落帝国“索要脑扫描数据”：五年随机脉冲（on_five_year_random_pulse_country_fe_list，common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:595-614）把本任务作为候选；各候选权重相对980，抽中后仍须通过其触发条件。（权重200。）条件：非AI默认国家，不在战争中，已有 limbo_downloaded 旗标（在“边缘”异常中下载了灭绝物种的脑扫描）且没有上传给机器人，全局尚未问过，且有狂热亲外的堕落帝国在保护区有空余居住空间。

A xenophile fallen empire "asks for brain scans": The five-year random pulse (on_five_year_random_pulse_country_fe_list, common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:595-614) lists this task among its candidates; weights are out of 980 and the event's own trigger must still pass. (weight 200.) Conditions: a human default country not at war with the limbo_downloaded flag (brain scans of an extinct species downloaded in the Limbo anomaly) that has not uploaded them into robots, nobody asked yet, and a fanatic-xenophile fallen empire with free preserve housing in contact.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

fallen_empires_tasks.24：对方请求复制这批数据以复活该物种。a 同意（物种在保护区复活，好感，我方设 limbo_revived）；b 拒绝（对方不悦）。

fallen_empires_tasks.24: the empire asks for a copy to revive the species. a agrees (the species is revived in the preserve, the empire is pleased, limbo_revived is set); b refuses (the empire is displeased).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

a 与 b 互斥。

a and b are exclusive.
